mapper.sql: menu_id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, route_path, component, icon, perm_code, sort_no, visible, state, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted, remark
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (menu_id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, route_path, component, icon, perm_code, sort_no, visible, state, created_by, remark) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{routePath}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{permCode}, #{sortNo}, #{visible}, #{state}, #{createdBy}, #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE sys_menu
parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_type = #{menuType}, route_path = #{routePath}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, perm_code = #{permCode}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, visible = #{visible}, state = #{state}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now()
WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND deleted = false
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND deleted = false
SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = false ORDER BY sort_no ASC, created_at ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.route_path, m.component, m.icon, m.perm_code, m.sort_no, m.visible, m.state, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_at, m.deleted, m.remark FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = false AND m.state = 'normal' AND m.menu_type <> 'button' ORDER BY m.sort_no ASC
SELECT DISTINCT rm.menu_id FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.perm_code FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = false AND r.state = 'normal' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = false AND m.state = 'normal' AND m.perm_code IS NOT NULL AND m.perm_code <> ''

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_menu WHERE perm_code = #{permCode} AND deleted = false
AND menu_id <> #{excludeId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET deleted = true, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND deleted = false
